BrochureContent.Content:
Lett-Duggan Properties Ltd are delighted to bring to the market 35 Glaslyn Apartments located off the Howth Road. No.35 is at the front of this private gated complex on the first floor. 
The entrance hallway leads to the master bedroom ensuite and a double sized bedroom both to the right. On the left of the hallway is the main bathroom and separate laundry room with ample storage.
The open plan kitchen has fully fitted units, a black granite work top with integrated appliances & tiled flooring. The dining area and living room have semi solid wood flooring and a door leading onto the balcony overlooking the communal gardens.
Glaslyn Apartments are situated within walking distance to Clontarf Dart Station. Conveniently, there is a bus stop just outside the complex with routes to the City Centre and surrounding suburbs. 
Clontarf offers a host of amenities to include cafes, bars, restaurants, sports clubs and not forgetting the coastal walk along Clontarf Promenade and St Anne’s Park. There are a variety of primary and secondary schools nearby.
Viewing is highly recommended.
